description: Manage products, stock, customers, suppliers, sales and purchases in Cin7 Core (formerly DEAR Inventory).

output.customer: The record returned by the service

cin7_new_sale_trigger.description: Runs for each new sale in Cin7 Core.

output.sale: The record returned by the service

cin7_product_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a product is created or changed.

output.product: The record returned by the service

cin7_purchase_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a purchase is created or changes, such as being authorized, received or invoiced.

output.purchase: The record returned by the service

output.sale: The record returned by the service
